北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感冷，多穿点，注意保暖别感冒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and feels cold. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有点凉，风力 3 级，出门带件外套哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool with a moderate breeze. Bring a jacket when you go out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云气温 9℃，穿暖点，出门注意温差喔。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, 9℃. Dress warmly and mind the temperature changes when you go out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，湿度有点高，出门心情美美哒！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and humid. Enjoy your beautiful day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾视线差，出行请注意安全，慢一点哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy, visibility is low. Please travel safely and slowly.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风大体感 5℃，多云凉，记得添衣别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is windy and feels like 5℃. It's cloudy and cool, remember to add layers.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 4℃。天气微凉，记得添衣喔。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 4℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to add clothes.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天湿度高，出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道健康。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze. Remember to wear a mask when going out for respiratory health.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感 3℃，风不大但有点冷，多穿点。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 3℃. Not very windy but chilly, dress warmly.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆下小雨，湿度大，出门记得带伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain and high humidity. Remember to bring an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨超冷！体感-25℃，把自己裹严实别冻着！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold! Feels like -25℃. Bundle up to stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感-16℃。寒风刺骨，注意防寒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cold, feels like -16℃. The wind is biting, stay warm!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明风力 4 级体感 7℃。晴朗但风大，别吹感冒了。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but windy, feels like 7℃. Don't let the wind make you sick.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 11℃。风力 3 级，记得防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 11℃. It's breezy, remember to protect from wind and stay warm.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大体感-1℃，晴朗但寒冷，多穿点哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and feels like -1℃. Sunny but cold, dress warmly!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感-13℃，风力 4 级。很冷，多添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -13℃ and windy. It's very cold, add more clothes.
